    {
      "task_id": "...",
      "status": "...",
      "request": "...",
      "priority": N,
      "created_at": "...",
      "reset_at": "...",
      "scope": "...",

Co-SMOS v1.1 — Archive Undo (Selected + Filter by status/date)

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/api/main.py, smos/core/queue_reset.py
- Frontend: frontend/index.html
- Existing:
    * POST /api/queue/reset-column (Задача 1)
    * GET /api/queue/archive/export?format=csv|md|jsonl (Задача 2)
- Archive format: .jules/queue/reset-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.jsonl
  Line format:
    {
      "task_id": "...",
      "status": "...",
      "request": "...",
      "priority": N,
      "created_at": "...",
      "reset_at": "...",
      "scope": "...",
      "restored": false,
      "why": {
        "source_task": null,
        "proposal_origin": null,
        "proposed_by": null,
        "history_transitions": [...]
      }
    }
- Problem: After reset, tasks are archived but cannot be restored.
  No Undo in UI. No filter by status/date.

GOAL:
1. Add POST /api/queue/archive/undo {archive_ids: [...], confirm: "UNDO"}
2. Add POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter {status, date_from, date_to, scope, search, confirm: "UNDO"}
3. Add GET /api/queue/archive (list archive entries, read-only)
4. Frontend: Reset Center panel with tabs:
    - Columns (existing reset buttons)
    - Archive (list with checkboxes)
    - Undo (filters + Undo Selected / Undo All Matched)
5. Shift+Click range selection for archive checkboxes

REQUIREMENTS:

1. GET /api/queue/archive
- Reads all .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl
- Response: {entries: [{archive_id, task_id, status, request, priority, created_at, reset_at, scope, restored}, ...]}
- archive_id = "<file>:<line_number>" (unique per entry)
- Auth: operator/admin

2. POST /api/queue/archive/undo
- Request: {archive_ids: [...], confirm: "UNDO"}
- For each archive_id:
    - Find the line in reset-*.jsonl
    - If restored == true → skip (already restored)
    - Create new Task:
        * request = entry.request
        * priority = entry.priority
        * status = "PENDING"
        * why = entry.why (preserve)
        - history_transitions = entry.why.history_transitions +
            [{timestamp: now, status: "PENDING", message: "RESTORED from <archive_id>"}]
    - Add to state.json / tasks
    - Mark archive line restored: true (rewrite .jsonl line)
- Response: {status, restored: [...], failed: [...]}

3. POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter
- Request: {status?, date_from?, date_to?, scope?, search?, confirm: "UNDO"}
- Find all archive entries matching filter:
    * status: entry.status == status
    * date_from: entry.reset_at >= date_from
    * date_to: entry.reset_at <= date_to
    * scope: entry.scope == scope
    * search: substring in entry.request or entry.task_id
- For each matching entry:
    - If restored == true → skip
    - Create new Task (same as undo)
    - Mark archive line restored: true
- Response: {status, matched: N, restored: [...], failed: [...]}

4. FRONTEND — Reset Center panel
- Section: id="view-reset-center"
- Navigation: <button data-view="reset-center">♻️ Reset Center</button>
- Tabs:
    * id="tab-columns" data-tab="columns"
    * id="tab-archive" data-tab="archive"
    * id="tab-undo"    data-tab="undo"
- Tab "Columns":
    * Keep existing reset buttons (btn-reset-ready..btn-reset-all)
- Tab "Archive":
    * Table id="archive-list"
    * Columns: checkbox, task_id, status, priority, reset_at, scope, restored
    * checkbox class="archive-select" data-archive-id="..."
    * Shift+Click range selection (JS)
- Tab "Undo":
    * Filters: undo-filter-status, undo-filter-from, undo-filter-to, undo-filter-scope, undo-filter-search
    * Shows "Matched: N tasks" (live count via POST /api/queue/archive/undo-filter with dry_run)
    * Buttons:
        - id="btn-undo-selected"      → "↩️ Undo Selected"
        - id="btn-undo-all-matched"   → "↩️ Undo All Matched"
    * Confirm modal: id="undo-confirm-modal", id="undo-confirm-input" (type "UNDO")
- CSS: .reset-center-tabs, .reset-tab, .archive-list, .archive-row, .archive-select,
    .undo-filters, .undo-filter-row, .undo-btn, .undo-matched-count

5. PRESERVE WHY
- When restoring, keep entry.why in the new task
- Add history_transition entry: "RESTORED from <archive_id>"

6. TESTS
- test_archive_list_returns_entries
- test_undo_selected_creates_tasks
- test_undo_marks_restored
- test_undo_preserves_why
- test_undo_skips_already_restored
- test_undo_filter_by_status
- test_undo_filter_by_date
- test_undo_filter_by_search
- test_undo_filter_returns_matched_count
- test_undo_requires_confirm
- test_undo_requires_operator
- frontend contract:
    * view-reset-center, tab-columns, tab-archive, tab-undo
    * archive-list, archive-row, archive-select
    * undo-filter-status, undo-filter-from, undo-filter-to, undo-filter-scope, undo-filter-search
    * btn-undo-selected, btn-undo-all-matched
    * undo-confirm-modal, undo-confirm-input

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/
- Allowed: read/rewrite .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl (mark restored: true)
- Allowed: update state.json (add restored tasks)

- Preserve WHY from archive.
- Handle empty archive gracefully.
